title: Full Of & The Utmost: ずくめ, まみれ, ぐるみ, きっての, 極まりない, の極み, の至り
description: Nothing but, covered in, the whole …, the best in, extremely (formal), the height of, and the utmost (honour / folly).

points.title: 〜ずくめ: nothing but
points.summary: Noun + ずくめ = entirely (often good things, or a colour: 黒ずくめ).
points.body: - いいこと**ずくめ**の一年.
examples: {彼|かれ}はいつも{黒|くろ}ずくめの{服装|ふくそう}だ。
He always dresses entirely in black.

points.title: 〜まみれ: covered in
points.summary: Noun (泥, 汗, 血, ほこり) + まみれ = smeared all over with.
points.body: - 泥**まみれ**になって遊ぶ.
examples: {汗|あせ}まみれになって{働|はたら}く。

points.title: 〜ぐるみ: the whole …
points.summary: Noun (家族, 町, 会社) + ぐるみ = all together, including everyone.
points.body: - 家族**ぐるみ**の付き合い.
examples: {町|まち}ぐるみで{祭|まつ}りを{準備|じゅんび}した。
The whole town got together to prepare the festival.

points.title: 〜きっての: the best in
points.summary: Place / group + きっての + noun = the most … in.
examples: {日本|にほん}きっての{名医|めいい}だ。
He's the finest doctor in Japan.

points.title: 〜極まりない / 極まる: extremely
points.summary: な-adjective + 極まりない / 極まる = utterly (usually negative, formal).
examples: {危険|きけん}{極|きわ}まりない{運転|うんてん}だ。

points.title: 〜の極み: the height of
points.summary: Noun + の極み = the very height of (贅沢, 疲労, 感激).
examples: {疲労|ひろう}の{極|きわ}みに{達|たっ}した。
I reached the height of exhaustion.

points.title: 〜の至り: the utmost
points.summary: Fixed: 光栄の至り (deeply honoured), 若気の至り (youthful folly), 感激の至り.
examples: {若気|わかげ}の{至|いた}りでした。

questions.prompt: {今年|ことし}はいいこと（　）の{一年|いちねん}だった。
questions.translation: This year was full of good things.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}はいつも{黒|くろ}（　）の{服装|ふくそう}だ。
notes: 黒ぐるみ isn't a phrase.
黒まみれ = smeared with black.
questions.translation: He always dresses entirely in black.

questions.prompt: {子供|こども}たちは{泥|どろ}（　）になって{遊|あそ}んでいた。
questions.translation: The children were playing, covered in mud.

questions.prompt: {汗|あせ}（　）になって{働|はたら}く。
{彼|かれ}とは{家族|かぞく}（　）の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いをしている。
notes: 家族きって isn't a phrase.

questions.prompt: What does 「{町|まち}ぐるみで{祭|まつ}りを{準備|じゅんび}した。」 mean?
options: Only part of the town prepared the festival.
The festival was prepared around the town.
The town was wrapped up for the festival.
The whole town got together to prepare the festival.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{社内|しゃない}（　）{秀才|しゅうさい}だ。
questions.translation: He's the brightest person in the company.

questions.prompt: What does 「{日本|にほん}きっての{名医|めいい}」 mean?
options: a famous doctor who left Japan
a doctor who cuts things in Japan
notes: きって isn't 切って.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}は{失礼|しつれい}（　）。
notes: Not the phrase (極まりない is fixed).

questions.prompt: What does 「{危険|きけん}{極|きわ}まりない{運転|うんてん}」 mean?
options: driving with no danger at all
notes: ない here doesn't negate the danger.

questions.prompt: {一流|いちりゅう}ホテルでの{食事|しょくじ}は{贅沢|ぜいたく}（　）だった。
notes: 贅沢極まりない sounds like criticism.
の至り is for fixed phrases (光栄, 若気).
questions.translation: Dinner at a top-class hotel was the height of luxury.

questions.prompt: What does 「{疲労|ひろう}の{極|きわ}みに{達|たっ}した。」 mean?
options: I reached the height of exhaustion.
I reached the summit despite being tired.
notes: 極み isn't a mountain top.

questions.prompt: このような{賞|しょう}をいただき、{光栄|こうえい}（　）です。
questions.translation: I'm deeply honoured to receive such an award.

questions.prompt: What does 「{若気|わかげ}の{至|いた}りでした。」 mean?
options: I arrived when I was young.
It was a young person's achievement.
It was the peak of my youth.
notes: 若気の至り = a mistake from youth.
